# LegacyHQ Design System

> React component library with a three-tier token architecture (primitive →
> semantic → component), CSS Modules, Storybook, and Vitest. 38 components
> across primitives/atoms/molecules/organisms.

Read [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) first — repo conventions, token tiers, prop-naming
rules, and the task→file routing table that says which of a component's up to
6 doc files to open for your specific task. Don't open all 6 for every task.

## Foundations (load once per session, not per component)

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): conventions, token tiers, routing table. Always first.
- [token-governance.json](docs/foundations/token-governance.json): token tier
  rules + stylelint enforcement policy. Load when touching any token/CSS value.
- [component-api-governance.json](docs/foundations/component-api-governance.json):
  prop-naming rules. Load when adding/renaming a prop.
- [registry.json](docs/components/registry.json): generated, normalized
  cross-component index (props/anatomy/sizes/slots/variants for all 38
  components in one consistent shape). Load for structural queries across
  many components instead of reading individual `.contract.json` files. See
  [component-registry-governance.json](docs/foundations/component-registry-governance.json)
  for normalization rules and known content gaps.
- [exemplars.json](docs/components/exemplars.json): generated, normalized
  cross-component runnable usage examples + anti-patterns for all 38
  components. Load for a quick, verified code example instead of reading
  individual `.examples.json` files. See
  [component-exemplars-governance.json](docs/foundations/component-exemplars-governance.json)
  for normalization rules and the completeness backlog.
- [design-code-mapping-governance.json](docs/foundations/design-code-mapping-governance.json):
  the `figmaSource` field every component's `.contract.json` (and
  `registry.json`) carries — real Figma node IDs, verified live, not
  invented. Load when tracing a component back to its design source or
  when re-verifying Figma mapping data.

## Optional

- `<name>-prompt.md` files (one per component): historical generation
  prompts. → Only read when regenerating a component from scratch or
  auditing prompt/output drift — not needed for normal edits.
